description: Source code for the AppendStream class in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library, implementing a read-only stream that concatenates multiple streams.

classes.name: AppendStream
classes.description: A read-only stream decorator that reads from multiple streams sequentially.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes AppendStream with an array of streams.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the concatenated contents of all streams as a string.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Adds a stream to the append list, ensuring it is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the combined contents of all streams.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all attached streams and resets internal state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches all streams and resets internal state.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates total size by summing sizes of all streams, or returns null if any size is unknown.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the combined stream has been reached.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the combined streams, only supporting SEEK_SET.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified length from the combined streams.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the stream is not writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns whether the stream is seekable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception; writing is not supported.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata; null if key provided, empty array if not.
